Sandbox_TraditionalPreservationYeast_Fer: How many in-game days a culture takes on the Fermenting Shelf at the best temperature.
Sandbox_TraditionalPreservationYeast_Tem: How much the cold or heat slows a culture. Off makes every culture take the same time, whatever the weather.
Sandbox_TraditionalPreservationYeast_Fro: A culture freezes at 0°C. A Fermenting Culture frozen for six hours in all goes hungry and wants a refresh; each hour frozen takes Active Culture, Hopped Culture and wet Yeast Cakes a share of their days, two days of frost spending them. Dried Yeast Cakes take no harm. A basement never freezes, nor a place by a lit fire or banked embers. Off, the cold only pauses them.
